financial_covenants.notes: LEASE-ADJUSTED leverage: Lease Adjusted Funded Debt = all Funded Debt plus six times rental or lease expense (s.1.1(137)); denominator is EBITDAR. Classified total_leverage_gross under the netting rule: neither Funded Debt nor Lease Adjusted Funded Debt subtracts cash, and the debt captured is all Funded Debt. s.10.3(iii) excludes floorplan/leasing/rental Debt, so this is effectively non-floorplan lease-adjusted leverage. Confirmed flat.

has_margin_grid_audit.method: Followed s.1.1(13) to s.4.3, read both pricing matrices from the exhibit's text layer, counted redacted cells per row against column headers, and read all 13 occurrences of 'Applicable Margin' for variation language.
has_margin_grid_audit.matrix_1: 'Applicable Margins' - columns Prime Loan | CDOR Loan | Standby Fee; one row each for Wholesale Flooring, Used Vehicle Flooring, Wholesale Leasing, Daily Rental; 3 cells per row. No tier, ratio, rating or utilization column.
has_margin_grid_audit.matrix_2: 'Applicable Margin - Revolving Facility' - columns Tier | Leverage Ratio | Prime Loan | CDOR Loan | Standby Fee | L/C Fee; five rows I-V. Keyed to the Leverage Ratio, reset on Compliance Certificate delivery, opening level Tier I.
has_margin_grid_audit.variation_language: All three sentences that make the margin vary are expressly confined to the Revolving Facility (s.4.3 twice, s.4.4). No template residue.
has_margin_grid_audit.caveat: All margin values are redacted, so the four false values rest on matrix shape plus the express confinement of variation language, not on reading the numbers.
has_margin_grid_audit.corpus_rationale_check: corpus.md row 14 said 'revolver only | Grid; leverage + fixed charge'. Grid holds at document level (1 of 5 facilities); covenants hold; structure wrong - five facilities, not one.
has_margin_grid_audit.exhibit_format: Page-image exhibit (193 JPGs) with a hidden 1-pt white text layer; no <table> elements. Text-extractable, so labelable, but table structure survives only as reading order.

labeler_hesitations.why_it_matters: Each vehicle-finance facility has a 'Revolving Nature' clause, so 'revolver' is defensible on label-governs. Resolved to 'other' because the enum's 'revolver' denotes a general-purpose corporate revolver, the agreement reserves 'the Revolving Facility' for s.2.1, and labeling all five 'revolver' produces an unresolvable alignment tie (two CAD $100,000,000 facilities). The alignment point is a defect in the alignment rule, not a fact about this document, and was recorded in schema.md on exclusion.

labeler_hesitations.field: Wholesale Flooring Facility - record or no record
labeler_hesitations.why_it_matters: Demand facility, excluded from 'Committed Facilities', but established at signing with a $500,000,000 limit and lender allocations on Schedule 1.1(43). Not an accordion and not a carve-out. Excluding it would drop 44% of the headline total.

Schema has two nulls, silence and deferral. Redaction is neither: the value exists in the executed agreement and is omitted from the filed exhibit, and the highest-level fallback is also redacted. This is the cost that decided the exclusion - five unlabelable records in a field carrying the hallucination finding.

Every facility permits Prime and CDOR Loans; Prime is the Canadian analogue of Base Rate and is the alternative per the rule. Swing line overdrafts are deemed CDOR Loans (s.2.1(6)(a)); Prime Rate is floored at CDOR + 100 bps (s.1.1(177)). Zero occurrences of SOFR or LIBOR in the document.
No calendar maturity anywhere; Termination Date is three years after the Closing Date. Closing Date is hard-coded June 3, 2022, but basis is decided by the maturity definition alone.
